[6:57AM]  #Ojo
#IyanaIba
#TrafficUpdate

We have smooth vehicular movement from Abule-Ado down to Iyana Iba intersection at the moment. 

Also, movement from Iyana Iba inward LASU/Igando road is looking good to Obadore bridge for now. 
Likewise the return journey is appreciable from Obadore back to Iyana Iba under bridge. 

Badagry Expressway is looking good from LASU main gate, Okokomaiko, Iyana Isashi, Iyana Era stretched to Agbara Custom Checkpoint. 
#FollowLASTMA
@TrafficChiefNG 
@trafficpalava 
@lagostraffic961

IN PHOTOS | Groups led by Cordillera women and Representatives of communities and people organizations hold up their protest placards during a demonstration Infront of the Department of Justice along Padre Faura in Manila, on Wednesday (November 26).

The rally coincides with the International Day to End Violence against Women (IDEVAW) and the governments so-called Mine (Un) Safety Week. 

📷 Norman Cruz

For more info, visit https://t.co/rmQCnNSOvI.
